I rarely leave reviews, but what happened yesterday was absolutely unacceptable and I will not stay silent about it.

We bought a tub cake to celebrate a birthday. Instead, it was completely ruined when we found a fly inside the cake. A FLY. In food meant to be eaten and celebrated with.

But what makes this even more infuriating is that this was not some freak accident. When we visited the store, there were flies visibly buzzing around the very area where the cakes were on display. This is not a one-off incident.. this is a hygiene failure. The display area was clearly not maintained to any acceptable standard, and yet cakes were being sold to unsuspecting customers without a second thought.

This is a basic food safety issue. Flies are carriers of bacteria and disease.. which i ate. The fact that customers are being served food in these conditions is not just disgusting.. it is a health hazard. Had a child eaten that cake, or had this happened to someone less composed, the consequences could have been far worse.

I strongly urge the management to take immediate action not just a surface level cleanup, but a thorough review of hygiene protocols, food storage practices, and display standards. This is not acceptable for any food establishment, let alone one selling celebration cakes.

Shame on you for letting it get to this point. Do better.

This was a very disturbing experience with Theobroma (BKC, Mumbai).

I am strictly vegetarian and had specifically ordered eggless pastries – Eggless Rich Chocolate Pastry and Fresh Cream Pineapple Pastry via Swiggy. However, what was delivered to me clearly contained egg. I realized this only after taking a bite and noticing the smell and taste. For someone who does not consume eggs at all, this is extremely upsetting and unacceptable.

When I contacted customer support, they initially denied the mistake. Only after I told them I was willing to send the pastry for lab testing did they apologize and promise that someone would pick up the incorrect item, conduct a quality check, and deliver eggless pastries.

That promise was never fulfilled. No pickup, no replacement, no follow-up.

Serving egg products to someone who has specifically ordered eggless food is a serious lapse in quality control and respect for dietary/religious choices. What is even worse is the attempt to deny the issue and then make false promises.

I expect Theobroma to publicly address this lapse and explain how such a mistake happened.

Recent order experience was pathetic

Delivery location - Santacruz east (10mins away from BKC)
Estimated delivery time before placing order - 20 mins

Moreover the status on the app still doesn't show as delivered - not sure if they're really bothered about it.

If your palate actively avoids overly sweet formulations, you will probably really enjoy this. For me, however, it was a pass.
​Custom Fruit Tea:
This was easily the best part of the order and the one I actually liked. I customized it with a Jasmine Tea base, Lychee syrup, and Passionfruit boba and jelly. The flavor formulation here worked wonderfully. While the lychee and passionfruit definitely provided a distinctly sweet profile, it was never cloying or aggressively sugary. The floral notes of the Jasmine tea base did an excellent job of cutting through the sugar, creating a balanced and refreshing beverage.
​The Verdict:
I would recommend skipping the mochi, and only order the Sakura Cooler if you prefer an unsweetened, tea-forward drink. However, their custom fruit teas are recommended.
